name: perf-tutorial
purpose: iter-464 perf lane (tools/perf/perf_run.py): tutorial_tape_full.json with a 5-minute dwell after the main_hud anchor (the tutorial flight era) and sparse present dumps (era witness frames only).

steps.name: await-ui-tail
steps.purpose: The exact named HintB request = the UI request tail proxy (APT_REQ #15 in the valid rolls; ScrGenPop, the dialog itself, is #16). NOT proof the dialog is ready - the settle + single-deadline pulses own that risk.

steps.name: settle-dialog
steps.purpose: Bounded settle after the request tail.

steps.name: clear-dialog
steps.purpose: Accept the storage dialog against ONE absolute deadline (the legacy driver waited expectMs twice). Confirmed transition = the runtime XamShowDeviceSelectorUI(user= invocation, never the import banner. DELIVERED only proves the guest sampled A.

steps.name: settle-modepage
steps.purpose: Let the mode-select page finish coming up before navigating it.

steps.name: select-mode
steps.purpose: Press A on whatever is focused. Blind by necessity - the item text does not render.

steps.name: nav-down
steps.purpose: Move the selection. DOWN is an EXTENDED key - without KEYEVENTF_EXTENDEDKEY the guest never sees it (iter-450V).

steps.name: nav-up-select
steps.purpose: And the other direction, in case the first item was the wrong one.

steps.name: await-main-hud-request
steps.purpose: The GUEST requests the in-game HUD package set: an APT witness of the era, nothing more (director ruling iter-453).

steps.name: skip-opening-movie
steps.purpose: iter-467 cutscene skip (owner 2026-10-11: a natural player action, not forcing; sr_drive -SkipCutscenes / SR_DRIVE_SKIP_CUTSCENES=0 turns it off): A pulses during the new game's opening FMV (the skip-movie action, event 187: A (alt) / START in the gameplay contexts, docs/PC_CONTROLS.md) until the movie is over: the player's first gameplay MODE ([PC_CONTROLS] context gameplay ... mode on-foot camera; the merge-ready gate showed pad A killing the opening FMV with NO [EV187] accept line), an [EV187] ... ACCEPTED-KILL edge, or the movie's own EOM if it ends first. The gate's in-game start takes either (tools/perf/perf_report.py MOVIE_SKIP). Optional: a missed skip only costs the movie's 30 s.
steps.expect: \[EV187\] #\d+ slot=\d+ rc=01 ACCEPTED-KILL|\[MOVIE_PACE\] movie#\d+ EOM wall=[\d.]+s frames=(?:[2-9]|[1-9]\d+)\b|\[PC_CONTROLS\] context gameplay \(igc type \d+\) config \S+ invX=\d+ invY=\d+ mode [a-z]

steps.name: tape-play
steps.purpose: The tape drives gameplay from the anchor; observe 5 minutes (the perf gameplay era).
